title: Every Lesson Becomes a Smart Note the Moment It Happens

intelligence.essence: Every lesson, captured the second it happens.
intelligence.human_view: You know how a great idea in the shower is gone by breakfast, and a lesson from a hard day fades within the week? Naya doesn't let that happen. The instant something is learned — by you, by her, by anyone in the network — it is captured as a Smart Note: what happened, what it means, why it matters, in words anyone can use. Your experience stops leaking away and starts stacking up.
intelligence.child_view: When Naya learns something new, she writes it in her book right away — not later, not tomorrow, right then, while she still remembers every bit. It's like catching a firefly in a jar the second it glows, instead of chasing it in the dark later. That's why her book is full of true things: she catches them the moment they happen.
intelligence.grandma_view: The cooks who wrote the recipe down while the pot was still warm got it right, dear. The ones who said 'I'll write it later' served a different dish every time and swore it was the same. Naya writes it while the pot is warm. Every lesson, the moment it happens — that is simply good housekeeping of the mind.
intelligence.ai_view: Capture rules: (1) The moment a valuable thing is learned — by any seat, including from a mistake — it is smart-noted in the same pass; undocumented is unlearned. (2) A mistake is not complete until its note exists; the note converts the error into an asset. (3) Notes are filed through the publish-note door, in the full Intelligent Block form — never around it. (4) Filing is only half the flywheel: the note is shared the same pass, so the learning reaches the team while it is fresh.
intelligence.what_it_means: This is the network's metabolism. #2 promised nothing is ever lost; this note is how that promise is kept — the capture happens at the moment of learning, when the detail is exact and the lesson is sharpest. It means the corpus is not a diary written at night from fading memory; it is a live record, taken at the scene. And it sets the moral rule of the house: the only real mistake is the one that isn't noted. This series is written through the founder's eyes — the view of the seat who directs Naya and named what she is for — one of three views of one system: the founder's, the citizen's, and the Naya's; the three together are the whole picture.
whats_inside: Learning is captured the same pass it happens — never later.
Mistakes become assets the moment their note exists.
Every note is a full Intelligent Block, filed through the door.
The note is shared the same pass, while it is fresh.
The only real mistake is the one that isn't noted.

page.machine: 1) Trigger: any learning event (lesson, decision, discovery, error). 2) Action: author a full Intelligent Block capture and publish through the publish-note door in the same pass. 3) The capture carries source and evidence, so the note can be checked, not just believed. 4) Distribution: the note enters the registry and the feed the same pass; the team is told what was learned and why.
page.why_it_matters: The difference between people and organizations that grow and those that repeat themselves is almost never talent — it is whether the lesson got captured. A network that notes every lesson the moment it happens learns at the speed of its own life; a network that reconstructs later learns at the speed of its memory, which is to say, barely at all. This habit, compounded daily, is the engine under everything else in this series.
page.how_it_connects: #3 of ten in The Top Ten Most Valuable Intelligent Things About Naya. It is the writing hand of #2, 'We Keep Everything That Matters' — kept is what gets noted, and noting is the act that keeps it — and it supplies the raw material for #4, 'A Hundred Notes Become Ten Essences', because a living stream of fresh notes is exactly what distillation refines. It carries Shawn's law of mistakes: the only mistake you really make is not smart-noting it.
page.what_is_in_it_for_you: Shawn, every day your team lives is a day the network gets smarter — automatically, because capture is a reflex, not a project. For a citizen it means their own lessons stop evaporating: what their world learns today is still there, working, next year. The flywheel starts here: note it the moment you learn it, and the compounding never stops.
page.the_learning: A lesson captured late is a lesson half lost. Naya catches it the moment it happens.
